scope: Local source review plus read-only remote CPU artifact audit; no GPU rerun or source/result edits

review_checks.evidence: RowWindow maps candidate hit rows through actor_lineage, using actor offset zero in black and static-row count in street. Only native a6 kind1/2 hits receive strength*sum(disjoint conditional cell masses); PVD/static/a37 remain untouched. Saved boxes equal the original36-cell geometry. Constant per-row .5 output matches the existing volume renderer exactly in all9 smoke cases.

Registration weight is joint parent alpha*T times the exact same Window.fraction that the action multiplies by persistent UID strength. Conditional mode is clamped by inherited halfspace and the full bounding box of the36-cell corridor. It describes the cropped portion. Threshold-induced disappearance and downstream transmittance changes are absent from this first-order dose; it is not exact post-intervention removal.

Consistency.reference rasterizes only cache[raw][3], the fixed lower431-PVD rows, and asserts alpha parity with frozen isolated_lower_alpha. Its unbinned alpha-weighted depth is computed before selecting native hits; no parent live/contribution mask filters this reference. Native witness T appropriately still belongs to the joint parent.

C uses trace.depth, the native raster sorting center, rather than feature[0]. The latter is independently checked against it for all affected hits. Saved smoke and all49 evaluation errors are included below.

The40 sparse frame ledgers reconstruct four aggregate mass rows, frame counts, frame maxima and qualifications. C and CM count their corresponding positive front-mass frames independently. No HELD sparse ledgers exist. Current parent/PVD/masks have previous full-scene context.

CM is a proper subset of C. Match coefficient is .5*sum(full_target[CM])/sum(full_target[C]), not a front-only sum. Float64 registered doses match exactly within numerical tolerance; the tiny applied float32 residual is reported separately.

All5 saved coefficient fields match the frozen formulas and same native IDs/boxes/ledger hash. Evaluation applies each shared vector in every frame/state. The primary dual fails guards and selected_state is the exact all-zero coefficient field.
The target remains431 lower PVD rows and26229 total target pixels. Every arm/state has the same per-frame isolated denominator. Current registration uses the BUILD subset of that fixed domain.

qualification_parameters.construction: 40 BUILD frames; all contributions use parent joint alpha*T times physical crop fraction
qualification_parameters.distinct_frame_definition: Frames with corresponding C or CM front contribution; each rule counted separately
qualification_parameters.protected_domain: (observed a6 RGB OR fixed original outside domain OR valid measured a6 depth) excluding fixed target
qualification_parameters.C: at least 80% of target crop contribution has native rendered center depth < proposal depth - 12cm
qualification_parameters.CM: at least 80% has both rendered center and conditional mode after inherited halfspace AND physical crop in front of the same reference
qualification_parameters.protection: qualification uses only the part being cropped; a mixed native row can retain its support outside the physical corridor
qualification_parameters.limits: Missing observations are not free space. No semantic identity truth, opaque first hit, new surface/color fitting or learned policy.

mass_decomposition.limits: C-D measures mode disagreement conditional on rendered center-front. G-D combines center and/or mode failures, so it is not a standalone all-mode-disagreement measurement. Independent exclusion shares can overlap; only waterfall stages are additive.

scientific_limits: This is a deterministic same-scene ablation of UID eligibility under a fixed native conditional crop. It is not a new renderer, a learned policy, or proof that retained/proposed geometry is correct.
The PVD is a frozen proposal and an evaluation reference, not hidden RGB/depth truth. Missing measurements do not establish free space.
Mode disagreement is known exactly only for center-front hits: C-D. Full-D includes center failures too and must not be relabeled entirely as mode inconsistency.

The protected-crop gate excludes about95.9% of total target contribution. The dual rule retains about2.8% and changes only2 of32 center-qualified IDs. Therefore this run does not solve the main mixed-support mass.

All qualified arms fail the same inherited black outside-RGB guard at raw97. The added per-pixel tail and parent-depth gates are not the rejection cause for those arms. Unqualified corridor is additionally rejected by substantial tail changes.
Per-frame parent depth-change bounds cover fixed measured a6 depth outside the target; they do not certify hidden target depth or all a37/road geometry.
First-order target-dose matching does not equalize actual post-intervention transmittance, revealed PVD contribution, protected mass, or per-UID concentration.
At least2 positive front-mass BUILD frames does not guarantee broadly distributed independent support; mass concentration is retained in registration.json.
The9 internal HELD frames have been repeatedly examined during mechanism development. They are diagnostics rather than an untouched test set, and full49 guard veto influences deployment.
Rejecting deployment at a small inherited-budget violation is the predeclared policy. The tiny matched-arm difference and unchanged observed imaging do not establish a general superiority of CM.

normalization_note.effect_on_current_qualified_C: None: all32 C-qualified IDs also satisfy legacy P/G<=.02; CM is nested
